name: SellRaze
description_en:
SellRaze helps secondhand sellers create listings from images, text or barcodes and manage listings across marketplaces. Its inventory context is individual resale items and the work needed to list, monitor, delist and ship them.

It is therefore a different comparison from a purchase-led warehouse system. The useful test is whether one physical item remains accurately represented across several marketplaces after edits and a sale.
description_zh:
SellRaze 帮助二手卖家从图片、文字或条码创建刊登，并跨市场管理。其库存语境是独立转售物品及刊登、监控、下架和发货工作。

这与采购驱动的仓库系统不同。评估重点是同一实物在多个市场中，经过编辑和售出后是否仍有准确一致的状态。

core_features.explanation_zh: 主页描述根据图片、文字和条码生成刊登，并提供定价建议。

core_features.explanation_en: The public offering describes marketplace connections, bulk updates and automatic delisting.
core_features.explanation_zh: 公开方案描述市场连接、批量更新及自动下架。

Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: List one used item and check every marketplace
sections.title_zh: 刊登一件二手物品并检查各市场
sections.en: Use an item whose model, condition and defects are known. Review generated specifications, description and suggested price before publishing to connected marketplaces. After a sale, verify the item is no longer buyable elsewhere and inspect the shipping task. This is a proposed test; no listing was published and automatic delisting latency was not measured.
sections.zh: 使用型号、成色和缺陷明确的物品，向已连接市场发布前审核生成规格、描述及建议价格。售出后检查其他市场是否已不可购买，并查看发货任务。这是建议测试；未实际发布刊登，也未测量自动下架延迟。

sections.en: The pricing page shows Premium at $44.99 per year, described as $3.75 monthly equivalent, with up to 25 new listings each month. Pro is $20 monthly for 125 and Elite $30 monthly for 250. Enterprise quotes unlimited monthly listing volume. The Premium annual amount should not be mistaken for a cancel-anytime $3.75 monthly charge.
sections.zh: 价格页显示 Premium 年付 $44.99，折算每月 $3.75，每月最多新增 25 刊登；Pro 月付 $20、125 刊登，Elite 月付 $30、250 刊登；Enterprise 询价并列出月刊登不限。Premium 年价不能误读为可随时取消的 $3.75 月付。

sections.en: Premium describes core listing tools and integrations; Pro adds higher volume, bulk creation and AI photo tools, with discounted labels. Free pickup wording appears in the package, but service geography, carriers and item eligibility were not established. Enterprise custom integrations are distinct from general marketplace support claims. Confirm exactly which account actions work on each intended marketplace.
sections.zh: Premium 描述核心刊登工具与集成；Pro 增加数量、批量创建及 AI 图片工具，并列出折扣运单。套餐有免费取件文字，但服务地区、承运商和物品资格未确认。Enterprise 定制集成与一般市场支持宣传不同，应逐个确认目标市场可执行的账户操作。

sections.title_en: Review AI output and single-item sale conflicts
sections.title_zh: 审核 AI 输出及单件销售冲突
sections.en: Suggested valuations and authenticity checks are vendor-described tools, not an independent appraisal or authenticity certificate. Resellers should verify item facts, defects and category rules themselves. A failed delist could matter for unique stock, so test revoked marketplace access and duplicate sale handling. Trial length, commissions, payout conditions and data export remain unresolved.
sections.zh: 估值建议和真伪检查是厂商工具描述，非独立估价或鉴定证书。卖家应自行核对事实、缺陷及分类规则。独立单件库存下架失败会产生影响，需测试市场授权失效和重复销售处理。试用时长、佣金、回款条件和数据导出仍未解决。
